statutory_act: LMPC Rules, 2011 read with Food Safety & Standards (Packaging and Labelling) Regulations, 2011

fssai_license.description: FSSAI logo and 14-digit FSSAI license/registration number on the principal display panel.
fssai_license.statutory_citation: FSSAI Packaging and Labelling Regulations, 2011: The FSSAI logo and license number shall be displayed on the label in contrast to the background.
fssai_license.remedy: Non-compliance penalty under Section 58 of FSS Act and Rule 6(1) LMPC.

veg_nonveg_logo.description: Green filled circle inside green outlined square (Veg) or Brown filled triangle/circle inside brown square (Non-Veg).
veg_nonveg_logo.statutory_citation: FSSAI Regulations: Every package of 'Vegetarian' / 'Non-Vegetarian' food shall bear a declaration in the form of a specified symbol.
veg_nonveg_logo.remedy: Notice for failure to declare dietary symbol.

best_before_expiry.rule_title: Best Before / Expiry / Use By Date
best_before_expiry.description: Best Before date or Expiry Date in Month/Year or DD/MM/YYYY format or 'Best before X months from manufacture'.
best_before_expiry.statutory_citation: Rule 6(1)(d) of LMPC Rules: The month and year indicating 'best before' or 'use by' date for perishable commodities.
best_before_expiry.remedy: Sale of expired/unmarked food punishable under FSS Act and LM Act.

ingredients_list.description: Complete list of ingredients in descending order of weight or volume, including nutritional information per 100g/serving.
ingredients_list.statutory_citation: FSSAI Regulations: Ingredients list and nutritional information per 100g or 100ml or per single consumption pack.
